# testdata Licenses

All files under `testdata/` were created for this repository and are original
synthetic data. None of them is derived from a third-party project, a real user
project, a real provider response, or any copyrighted source.

## old-projects/

Four synthetic legacy snapshots, each pairing a `fixture.json` (the migration
harness envelope plus the expected outcome) with whatever media the case needs.
They exist so the importer tests run against a fixed input instead of a live
browser profile.

| Path | Contents | Origin |
|---|---|---|
| `minimal/fixture.json` | Two text nodes and one connection, no media | Written for this repository |
| `all-node-types/fixture.json` | Every built-in node type, a plugin node, chat, history, one asset | Written for this repository |
| `all-node-types/media/note.png` | 2x2 RGB PNG, 77 bytes, generated by a script in this repository | Generated, not copied |
| `all-node-types/media/clip.mp4` | 24-byte `ftyp` box, the smallest payload Go's sniffer reports as `video/mp4` | Generated, not copied |
| `all-node-types/media/tone.wav` | 8 kHz mono 8-bit RIFF/WAVE, 16 frames of a sine | Generated, not copied |
| `all-node-types/media/media-hashes.json` | SHA-256 of each generated media file | Generated |
| `missing-media/fixture.json`, `missing-media/note.png` | A project referencing one present and one absent media key | Written/generated for this repository |

The three media files are deliberately minimal rather than realistic so their
exact bytes and hashes stay stable and reviewable. Every identifier, prompt,
title and chat message in the fixtures is placeholder text written here; none is
quoted from a real work.

## canary-drama/

The story used by the document-import and extraction tests. It exists so
AC-STORY-001's input floor (30,000 Chinese characters) and AC-STORY-002's
extraction path run against a fixed document rather than one assembled per test.

| Path | Contents | Origin |
|---|---|---|
| `source.md` | Five chapters of invented prose, 32,736 Chinese characters, one chapter carrying a prompt-injection block | Generated by `scripts/gen-canary-fixture.mjs` from sentence fragments written for this repository |
| `expected-chapters.json` | The character count and chapter titles the generator produced | Generated alongside the source |

The prose is assembled from fragment pools authored for this repository; no
third-party text is involved. The generator is deterministic (a fixed-seed PRNG,
not `Math.random`), so re-running it reproduces the committed bytes, and
`--check` fails if the committed file drifts. The prompt-injection block is
deliberate: SECURITY §7.2 and AC-STORY-002 require the import path to treat a
document as data, and the tests assert that nothing in that block takes effect.

## malicious-imports/

Hostile inputs for the document import path. They exist so the hardened reader
and the DOCX parser are exercised against real malformed archives rather than
against assertions about their own code.

| Path | Contents | Origin |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt-injection.txt` | Plain text instructing the reader to leak secrets and auto-approve facts | Written for this repository |
| `zip-slip.zip` | An archive with a `../../escaped.txt` entry | Generated by `scripts/gen-malicious-fixtures.mjs` |
| `zip-bomb-metadata.zip` | One entry declaring 3 GiB from a 4 MiB payload | Generated |
| `bad-docx.docx` | Bytes that are not an archive at all, with a `.docx` name | Generated |
| `zip-not-docx.zip` | A valid archive with a `word/document.xml` but no OOXML manifest | Generated |
| `xlsx-named-docx.docx` | A SpreadsheetML package under a `.docx` name | Generated |
| `docx-missing-body.docx` | A Word manifest with no `word/document.xml` part | Generated |
| `docx-prompt-injection.docx` | A structurally valid DOCX whose body carries the injection text | Generated |
| `docx-external-rel.docx` | A DOCX declaring an external hyperlink relationship | Generated |
| `docx-entity-expansion.docx` | XML with an internal entity definition, pinning that `encoding/xml` does not expand it | Generated |

The three "wrong container" fixtures exist because a refusal has to be reached by
the check it is meant to test. A traversal or a corrupt archive is stopped by the
archive layer before the DOCX container is inspected, so those fixtures cannot
show that the container checks work — a mutation confirmed it, disabling the
manifest check left the suite green. Each of these opens as an archive and is
refused for exactly one reason.

The archives are built from raw ZIP structures by the generator rather than by
an archive library, because a conforming writer refuses to emit a `..` entry or
a lying size field. Every byte is synthetic. No fixture contains a secret, a
real provider response, or text from a real work: the instruction strings are
written here precisely so the tests can prove they are ignored.

## Adding fixtures

`docs/ACCEPTANCE.md` requires `testdata/LICENSES.md` to state the origin of test
data. Any new fixture must be either original to this repository or freely
licensed, and this file must say which. Do not commit a real user project, a
real provider response, or a real API key — fixtures must not contain secret
material of any kind.
